case_study_packaging.readiness_notes: Client identity, objectives, quantified savings ($426K finalized / $803K total identified), and multiple signed agreements provide a solid fact-base for a compelling case study.
case_study_packaging.headline: PE-backed HVAC services platform unlocks $803K in annual savings in four months through Treya-led OEM rebate renegotiations
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Cascade Services, a rapidly expanding residential HVAC, plumbing, and electrical services consolidator, purchased everything locally at branch level, leaving millions in purchasing power untapped. With private-equity sponsors targeting swift enterprise-value creation, the company needed to centralize procurement, leverage multi-brand volume, and secure hard savings inside a six-month window. Internal data gaps, fragmented supplier relationships, and an aggressive timeline made outside expertise essential.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A rapidly expanding residential HVAC, plumbing, and electrical services platform purchased everything locally at branch level, leaving millions in purchasing power untapped. With the private equity ownership group targeting swift enterprise-value creation, the company needed to centralize procurement, leverage multi-brand volume, and secure hard savings inside a six-month window. Internal data gaps, fragmented supplier relationships, and an aggressive timeline made outside expertise essential.
approach_summary: Analyzed $26.5M in addressable spend across nine categories to pinpoint rebate, pricing, and consolidation opportunities.
Renegotiated national OEM programs with Carrier and Rheem—securing rebate tiers up to 16% and immediate front-end price concessions.
Structured a competitive sourcing event for HVACR & plumbing supplies, drafting MOUs that lock pricing and add early-pay discounts.
Leveraged a Rampart GPO partnership to consolidate uniform rentals under Unifirst, delivering a projected 43% cost reduction.
Established standardized rebate trackers, national contract templates, and a repeatable sourcing playbook to support future add-on acquisitions.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya has delivered $426K in contracted annual run-rate savings and identified a total of $803K across six categories—representing nearly 2× the fixed project fee and positioning the client to surpass its $850K minimum savings guarantee once remaining agreements are signed. Beyond the dollars, Treya stood up national pricing, standardized rebate structures, and a scalable procurement process that will streamline future integrations and boost visibility into spend.
where_we_were_unique: Delivered the first signed savings agreement (Carrier) within 120 days of kick-off, well ahead of the six-month target.
Deep HVAC OEM expertise unlocked rebate tiers unavailable through traditional distributor programs.
Hands-on creation of supplier MOUs and rebate trackers gave the client a turnkey, repeatable procurement toolkit.
Collaborative change-management approach navigated decentralized branches and incumbent sensitivities without disrupting field operations.
